chapter.heading: The Majesty and Condescension of God
chapter.v:
Praise the
Lord!Praise, O servants of the Lord,Praise the name of the Lord!

Blessed be
the name of the LordFrom this time forth and forevermore!

From the
rising of the sun to its going downThe Lord’s name is to be praised.

The Lord
is high above all nations,His glory above the heavens.

Who is
like the Lord our God,Who dwells on high,

Who humbles
Himself to beholdThe things that are in the heavens and in the earth?

He raises
the poor out of the dust,And lifts the needy out of the ash heap,

That He
may seat him with princes—With the princes of His people.

He grants
the barren woman a home,Like a joyful mother of children.Praise the Lord!
